signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office

bullets: Own the B2B product roadmap, using customer insight and data to prioritize brand management, creation workflows and enterprise platform capabilities.
Understand how employees create work today, where brand teams spend time repairing or reviewing it, and what prevents companies from trusting the result. Turn those insights into…
Partner with Design and Engineering to turn ambiguous problems into simple product experiences, from early exploration through launch and iteration.
Define how we’ll evaluate quality and reliability in AI-generated work. Use product data, output reviews and customer research to decide what to improve.
Connect better customer outcomes to repeated use, retention and expansion. Make clear choices about which requests to pursue and which to decline.
